title: What Meal Planning Basics Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of meal planning basics: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Meal planning = decide once, shop once, cook calmly. Plan 5-7 dinners weekly around what's on sale; the plan is the grocery list's boss.

Why it matters: Planners waste ~30% less food Theme nights (taco Tuesday) simplify decisions

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.
facts: Meal planning = decide once, shop once, cook calmly. Plan 5-7 dinners weekly around what's on sale; the plan is the grocery list's boss.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Meal Planning Basics
summary: Start meal planning basics this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Check calendar for busy nights
2. Inventory fridge/pantry
3. Pick 5-7 dinners (theme nights help)
4. Write the grocery list from the plan
5. Shop once

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Meal Planning Basics Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with meal planning basics — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Planning 7 ambitious new recipes → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- No flexibility for schedule changes → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Ignoring leftovers as planned meals → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Planning without checking the calendar → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

body:
